NONE: › to use something slowly or carefully because you only have a small amount of it
精打細算地維持；儘量節約使用

example: There wasn't much food left, but we just managed to eke it out.
剩下的食物不多，但是我們省吃減用設法熬了過來。
He managed to eke out a living (= earn just enough to live on) one summer by selling drinks on a beach.
他靠著在海灘上賣飲料設法撐過了一個夏天。
